note: Own procedural textures (tools/make_hub_tex.py). Sheet: out/hub1/tex_sheet.jpg. 'studs_per_tile' = MaterialVariant.StudsPerTile or Texture.StudsPerTileU x V. Shown 2x2 tiled on the sheet to prove seams.

hub_concrete_smooth_*.use: MaterialVariant 'TacConcrete' (base Concrete) = MaterialService Concrete override; all wall mass, frames, ceilings

hub_concrete_panels_*.use: MaterialVariant 'TacConcretePanels' (base Concrete): wall bay plates, door-frame cheeks, cladding
hub_concrete_panels_*.note: one tile = 2x2 panels of 10 studs, offset sub-seams, corner bolts

hub_corrugated_metal_*.use: MaterialVariant 'TacCorrugatedMetal' (base Metal): tunnel cladding, crate panels, upper shell bands, catwalk kick plates
hub_corrugated_metal_*.note: 8 trapezoid ribs per tile, ribs run along V

hub_corrugated_fine_*.use: MaterialVariant 'TacRibbed' (base Concrete): upper wall band shells and roof soffit panels (ribs from normal only)

hub_metal_floorplate_*.use: MaterialVariant 'TacFloorPlate' (base Metal or DiamondPlate override): centre ring plates, landing, catwalk/bridge decks, door thresholds
hub_metal_floorplate_*.note: 4x4 plates of 5 studs, checker tread inserts, bolts

hub_floor_concrete_*.use: MaterialVariant 'TacFloorConcrete' (base Concrete, used only on floor slabs): hub floor field and borders (tinted 36-62)
hub_floor_concrete_*.note: sealed, low roughness, trowel arcs in roughness, 10-stud saw cuts

hub_metal_satin_*.use: MaterialVariant 'TacMetal' (base Metal) = MaterialService Metal override: trims, kerbs, pilaster caps, rails, door leaves

hub_overlay_panel_lines.png.use: Texture (Top face), Color3 ~81 grey, Transparency 0 (0.9 as dark overlay): spawn-disc plates, pad floors, landing

hub_overlay_grid.png.use: Texture, all faces, Transparency 0.75, Color3 black: training range boxes (not used in the hub)

hub_grate_alpha.png.use: Texture (Top) on near-black host part, Color3 70-80: drain grates round the spawn disc, catwalk deck insets
hub_grate_alpha.png.extra: hub_grate_normal.png if used as a SurfaceAppearance with AlphaMode Transparency

hub_trim_strip.png.use: Texture (front faces), Color3 59-81 grey: door reveals, the 2x4 display-wall role, panel strip above the olive band

hub_grime_overlay.png.use: Texture, Color3 black, Transparency 0.92-0.95: lower wall kick zones and props only (never on bands or floors)

hub_hazard_stripe.png.use: Texture (Top/front), Color3 white: pad edges, lift edges, kerb faces at the riser, KEEP CLEAR zones (cream on near-black)

hub_lane_marking.png.use: Texture/Decal (Top), Color3 cream 236,232,218 at 0.2 transp.: runway lane marking along walkways into each gate (edge lines + dashes)

hub_chevron.png.use: Decal (Top), cream: direction chevrons toward gates

hub_louvre.png.use: Texture (Bottom) on Neon ceiling strips, Color3 black, Transparency 0.5
